# möbius for macOS 0.10.21

- Provider errors place their recovery action beside Details as a small arrow.
- Long model names fit inside the model and reasoning picker.
- Session card drag handles appear directly after their titles, without a hover highlight.
- Opening an output preview slides the side panel in while keeping the preview at its full width.
- Session and provider connections use the core's checked identifiers and addresses.
- Bundles gateway 0.16.40, with protocol 95 unchanged.
